tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Content canvas: the workspace, the 700px conversation rail and assistant answers, which sit directly on it.

tokens.name: structural
tokens.usage: Structural chrome: the 280px sidebar and other quiet frames around content.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Contained interaction: composer, selected sidebar row, chips, user-message surface. Use the shift from canvas instead of a border.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary content on canvas (12.3:1), structural (12.0:1) and surface (11.0:1): answers, titles, form labels, medical conclusions.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting content on canvas (5.2:1) and structural (5.1:1); 4.65:1 on surface. Descriptions, source lines, secondary labels.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Non-critical metadata, placeholders and tertiary labels only. 2.84:1 on canvas, below 4.5:1 (source value kept): never for conclusions, instructions, validation errors, source titles or required labels.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Subtle structural hairline, used at low opacity. Decorative only (2.0:1 on canvas): never the sole boundary of a control; prefer a surface shift.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one accent: primary action fill, selection, focus and active state. 3.68:1 on canvas, so it carries icons, focus rings and text 24px+; smaller accent-coloured text uses accent-ink. A white label on this fill is 3.68:1, below 4.5:1 (source pair, flagged).

tokens.name: accent-brand
tokens.usage: The mark's disc colour (logo, favicon, app icon) and illustration fills. Not for text or white-label fills (2.92:1).

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Accent-coloured text and icons on canvas (5.15:1), accent-wash (4.72:1) and surface (4.60:1); 4.41:1 on accent-soft, so keep text there 14px semibold or larger.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Accent tint behind selected or hovered accent content, and the border of featured cards.

tokens.name: accent-wash
tokens.usage: Lightest accent tint: background of the one primary or featured card in a group.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px solid outline, offset 2px. 3.68:1 on canvas, 3.29:1 on surface.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error and high clinical risk: text and icons on canvas (6.6:1) and danger-soft (6.0:1). Always with a written label: it differs from success by hue, not lightness.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of an error or high-risk result block, under danger text.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Caution and borderline values: text and icons on canvas (5.9:1) and warning-soft (5.6:1), always with a written label.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a caution block, under warning text.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Normal range, completed, verified: text and icons on canvas (5.3:1) and success-soft (4.9:1), always with a written label.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a success or normal-range block, under success text.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Backdrop dimming under a mobile bottom sheet, drawer or dialog; the active content above stays fully legible.

tokens.name: inverse-surface
tokens.usage: Tooltips and dark labels over media.

tokens.name: inverse-text
tokens.usage: Text on inverse-surface (18.7:1) and labels on an accent fill (3.68:1, see accent).

tokens.name: inverse-text-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text on inverse-surface (9.7:1).

spacing.note: 4px base grid; 8px is the normal interaction rhythm.

tokens.usage: Base grid step: icon to text, tightly related controls.

tokens.name: space-8

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Padding and gaps inside professional tools and calculators.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Default component padding.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Between related sections inside a panel or answer.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Between related sections; card padding in the feed.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Major composition boundary.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Major composition boundary.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Largest composition boundary, e.g. above the composer or between page regions.

radius.note: No single universal radius: each radius belongs to a kind of object.

tokens.name: radius-tag
tokens.usage: Tags, feed tabs, small status labels, inline search button.

tokens.name: radius-button
tokens.usage: Application shell, sidebar rows, compact controls, square action buttons, primary button.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Suggestion chips and compact pills (36px high).

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards and modules inside an answer or feed: tool, result, source preview.

tokens.name: radius-composer
tokens.usage: The chat composer only.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Dialogs, featured cards, media viewers, empty states.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Genuinely circular controls only: send button, avatar, disc icons.

shadow.note: Neutral surfaces carry structure; shadows mark interaction and layering, never decoration.

tokens.name: shadow-focus
